config.protocol: Hold calibration subjects out of all new training, normalization, BatchNorm and epoch selection; select on original validation, refit on proper-fit plus tuning only. Existing default checkpoint is never calibrated or replaced.
config.limitations: Research extension on a historically reused dataset, one seed; tests already inspected in earlier phases. Empirical coverage under domain shift, not unconditional deployment guarantees.

calibrator.coverage_unit: New subject bundle, all supplied photos. Per-target marginal; joint radius covers all 3 targets together.
calibrator.limitations: Exchangeability required; subject/photo-count/capture domain shift and historical dataset reuse can invalidate guarantees. Not an individual health confidence probability.
